S7 IMPLEMENTATION PLAN COMPLETE.

**Approach**: P1 — Modular layering with 3 new modules (file_filter.py + region_split.py Strategy F + aggregator.py) matching established dso_ci_review/ small-module pattern.

**Tasks (11)**:
- T1 (07bb) RED file_filter unit tests [no deps]
- T2 (9bba) IMPL file_filter.py [depends T1]
- T3 (d905) UPDATE-RED region_split Strategy F + single-oversized-file [depends T2]
- T4 (ef84) IMPL region_split Strategy F + single-oversized-file decision [depends T3]
- T5 (c178) RED aggregator (post-S2 signature + failure modes) [depends T4]
- T6 (6098) IMPL aggregator.py [depends T5, S2.T2 cross-story]
- T7 (0b31) IMPL runner.py orchestration + OVER_BOUND + config validation (max_calls >= max_files+1) [depends T6]
- T8 (773d) UPDATE /dso:fp-recovery rejects OVER_BOUND [depends T7]
- T9 (3e25) RED E2E synthetic fixtures [depends T7, T8]
- T10 (8ca8) DOC CI-INTEGRATION + CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE [depends T7]
- T11 (NEW) IMPL verify-session-provenance.sh exit-code 3 for OVER_BOUND + ci.yml handler [depends T7, S1.T5 cross-story]

**Plan-Review + Gap-Analysis combined**: 6 findings (2 critical, 3 major, 1 minor) plus 6 amendments. Applied:
- Cross-story dep T6 \xe2\x86\x92 S2.T2 (append_cycle signature change)
- Cross-story dep T11 \xe2\x86\x92 S1.T5 (verify-session-provenance.sh extension)
- Single-oversized-file decision (T3/T4): pass-through with oversized_single_file flag
- Failure-mode handlers in T5/T6 (aggregation malformed, gitattributes parse, schema exhaust)
- T7 single-task discipline kept (not split) but sub-AC items added
- max_calls >= max_files+1 validation (T7)
- NEW T11 closes the OVER_BOUND/provenance-gate gap
